payload.posture: Read 2 Chronicles 20:4–12 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states jehoshaphat’s prayer names God in heaven, ruler over kingdoms, and possessor of power no one can withstand. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
